_comment: Default minimum wall 0.6 mm (thinnest printable SLS PA12 vertical wall: Formlabs Fuse 0.6 mm, Stratasys 0.6 mm possible / 0.8 recommended). Fine topology-optimisation runs. Each entry: Setup parameters for analysis/topo.py plus t_min (minimum wall, enforced on the output geometry), verify_h (tet size of the full-accuracy check) and verify_step_deg. Loads model the wheel ROLLING on flat ground: the 20 N radial press and the 20 N diametral pinch are applied at every position across one symmetry sector - every 5 deg in the optimiser (n_phi per sector) and every 1 deg in the final check (effectively continuous), plus the 1 N running load and 20 000 rpm spin. No edge or axial loads. Objective: minimum rotational inertia of the wheel body (bearings excluded); constraint: von Mises <= sigma_target (default 0.9 x UTS/2).

runs.name: r05_N6_skin0.4
runs.note: thinner skin for a process that can print 0.4 mm walls (e.g. MJF / fine SLA); still SLS PA12 properties
